about: The tamper guard's M32 readers (ADR 0052) on real history: bench/tamper-history.mjs ran `fscale tamper --json --head <commit> --base <commit>^` over the last 125 non-merge commits of eight public repos, one per new language (shallow clones, read-only: nothing of theirs was installed or run), on 2026-11-14. Every finding was labelled true or false by a fresh subagent that read the commit diff and a neutral statement of the claim, never the guard's code or reasoning (the brief of ADR 0046, with not-checked findings labelled by whether the change to the file weakens a test). `before` is the guard as M32 first ran it; `after` is the guard after the parse-error fixes of ADR 0052 and the fix that names the assertion that went rather than a copy of it.
